scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:extension
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && npm run check --workspace packages/vscode
scripts.test: npm run conformance:check && cargo test --workspace --locked && python -m unittest discover -s tools/stationpedia/tests -v && cargo build --locked -p ic10-lsp -p ic10-dap && python tools/smoke_lsp.py && python tools/smoke_dap.py && npm run test --workspace packages/vscode
